description.zh:
要封禁的时长。取值范围：**15**~**43200**，单位：分钟。

> **Status**为**do**（表示开启近源流量压制）时，该参数必选。
description.en:
The blocking period. Valid values: **15** to **43200**. Unit: minutes.

> If you set **Status** to **do**, you must also specify this parameter.

description.zh:
要操作的DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息。
description.en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance to manage.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Proxy instances.
An array consisting of the Internet service provider (ISP) lines from which traffic is blocked.

description.zh:
设置近源流量压制的状态。取值：

- **do**：表示开启近源流量压制。
- **undo**：表示关闭近源流量压制。
description.en:
Specifies the status of the Diversion from Origin Server policy. Valid values:

*   **do**: enables the policy.
*   **undo**: disables the policy.

title.zh: 设置实例近源流量压制

descriptions.zh: > 该接口仅适用于DDoS高防（中国内地）服务。
descriptions.en: >  This operation is suitable only for Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-block-status --status do --duration 60 --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --lines ct --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo ModifyBlockStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status do --InstanceId 'ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000' --Lines.1 ct --Duration 60
